infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to center the shift map near you and sort shifts by distance.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SNAP accesses your photo library only when you choose a profile photo. For example, when you tap your avatar on the Profile tab, you can select a photo from your library to use as the profile picture facilities see when booking you for shifts.
